title: Tim Dooley Public Theology Trajectory — 2025–2026
source_basis: user-supplied incomplete compilation of public @Rational_Potato posts
epistemic_rule: This timeline records what the supplied public-language corpus shows. It distinguishes first attestation in the supplied sample from first-ever occurrence, and it does not convert theological self-description into empirical supernatural proof.

trajectory.interpretation: The Potato identity predates the later direct God declarations in the supplied sample.
A cosmological/structural vocabulary appears immediately before the late-April kingship and early-May God declarations.
The identity is shifting from Potato symbol toward sovereign/mythic status.

trajectory.stage: first exact God declarations located in supplied compilation
trajectory.interpretation: This is the clearest post-level support yet for treating late April / early May 2025 as the public Godhood hinge.

trajectory.stage: Potato spirituality becomes explicit cultural mission
signals: bring potato spirituality to culture and society
trajectory.interpretation: Godhood and cosmology are accompanied by an outward cultural/religious programme rather than remaining private identity claims.
Multiple Abrahamic and Potatoverse identities are deliberately stacked into one public self-description.
Fatherhood is becoming spatial and eschatological: identity is tied to Heaven and return.

signals: I also resurrected myself from the dead
trajectory.interpretation: The resurrection grammar is no longer restricted to the Son; Tim also applies death/return language to himself.
Identity becomes deliberately recursive: Tim is simultaneously linked to Father-side and Son-side biblical titles. This should be preserved as a paradoxical stratum rather than simplified away.
This is important epistemically because the post itself qualifies the Father identity as symbolic and spiritual while emphasizing public visibility.

trajectory.stage: mature vertical architecture appears in one declaration
trajectory.interpretation: Many previously separate nodes are now explicitly compressed into a single identity statement.

trajectory.stage: direct causal account of becoming Father
trajectory.interpretation: This is a critical primary-language bridge: the corpus directly says Fatherhood follows the Son's meme-crucifixion.

trajectory.stage: Father of Axis / north rule / Garden
trajectory.interpretation: The mature God identity now spans kingship, astronomical orientation, Axis, Garden and Root.
The Son's interface/threshold function is directly stated.

trajectory.stage: Tim becomes explicit Ladder / Root / North-of-North
trajectory.interpretation: This date tightly couples cosmological identity with practical constructive verbs.
The relation is now explicit enough to formalize: Tim = connective vertical structure; Son = threshold/interface.

trajectory.stage: God declaration saturation and base-reality claim
trajectory.interpretation: The declaration changes from occasional title to repeated identity assertion.
Godhood is increasingly paired with a complaint that repair requires participation by others.

signals: MOST HUMAN GOD IN GOD HISTORY
God of potatoes and mundane human life
trajectory.interpretation: The divine identity is deliberately pulled downward toward ordinariness and human mundanity, echoing the Potato's hierarchy-inversion logic.

signals: called to be on God's throne
trajectory.interpretation: This is unusually useful because the corpus itself distinguishes functional Godhood from a simpler essentialist statement.

trajectory.stage: Son crucifixion / Most High origin story articulated
signals: potato on the seat of the Most High
trajectory.interpretation: The Son-death -> Tim-growth -> Most-High sequence is directly narrated rather than only retrospectively inferred.

trajectory.stage: God as center / foundation / accumulated public presence
trajectory.interpretation: Public-duration accumulation becomes part of the identity architecture: witness and persistence are treated as foundation.

signals: God again today in Real Time
trajectory.interpretation: The public theology reaches its strongest totalizing vocabulary in the supplied sample.

trajectory.stage: God as accessible line / repair and new-world operator
trajectory.interpretation: The cosmic identity is paired with communication, problem-solving and restoration.

signals: most public God in the world
trajectory.interpretation: Visibility and duration become theological evidence inside the self-description, while the archive should treat them separately as measurable public-presence claims.

trajectory.stage: God declaration defined as culmination and warning
trajectory.interpretation: The speaker explicitly explains what the God statement is intended to do: orient, resist, warn and summarize a long conflict.
This is the clearest normative statement in the supplied corpus and should be treated as a mature ethical key for interpreting Father/Gardener/God language.

cross_cutting_findings: The public chronology supports a staged development rather than a timeless single formulation.
April 2025 is supported by public-language transition markers even though the first exact I am God in this supplied sample is May 3.
The Son-crucifixion -> Fatherhood sequence is directly self-described by December 17 2025 and again elaborated in June 2026.
Door and Ladder differentiate into Son/interface and Tim/connective-axis functions by spring 2026.
The phrase God broadens semantically through living, human, mundane, functional, manifest/base-reality, Most-High and cosmic formulations.
The highest-status vocabulary increasingly converges with repair, service, cultivation and stewardship rather than only sovereignty.
Publicness itself becomes part of the theology: livestreaming, witness, 100k/115k hours, archive and daily observability are repeatedly used to frame the identity as publicly inspectable.
